meta.title: Add destructor for arrow icons
meta.body_summary: Add a virtual destructor to CharacterDisplayRenderer to delete dynamically allocated upArrow and downArrow arrays, fixing potential memory leak.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit destructor addition to free arrow icon memory; coderabbitai CHANGES_REQUESTED rule-of-five and smart pointer suggestions post-merge, not addressed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 17 changed lines, this is a tiny change by absolute volume. It fits a minimal reliable fix that was self-merged by the maintainer without waiting for review, which is consistent with a high-trust, low-risk fix.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbitai noted that the class lacks copy/move constructors and assignment operators, risking double deletions on shallow copies; recommended using unique_ptr or deleting copy/move operations.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix memory leak by freeing dynamically allocated arrow icons on destruction.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a destructor for raw pointer cleanup is within Agent capability; the review surfaced deeper C++ ownership concerns (rule-of-five) that were ignored post-merge, indicating that Agent-generated fixes may not address broader design patterns.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer noticed missing cleanup of arrow arrays and added destructor.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, no profiler, no leak reproduction; only narrative summary by CodeRabbit.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: coderabbitai CHANGES_REQUESTED suggestions for rule-of-five and smart pointers were not implemented after merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added virtual destructor ~CharacterDisplayRenderer() in CharacterDisplayRenderer.cpp that delete[]s the dynamically allocated upArrow and downArrow arrays, with doc comment in header.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding destructor to free arrow icon arrays.

review_signals.summary: Bot posted CHANGES_REQUESTED with two actionable inline comments about potential double-delete and rule-of-five.
Destructor alone is insufficient; without copy/move restrictions, shallow copies lead to double deletion; suggested deleting copy/move or using unique_ptr.
Replace raw pointers with unique_ptr<uint8_t[]> for automatic management, and use override if base class destructor is virtual.
Memory usage change report across boards; all show small increases in flash and sometimes RAM.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by maintainer with single commit adding destructor.
github-actions posted memory usage change report.
Maintainer merged PR after 15 minutes, before coderabbitai review was submitted (review appeared 40 seconds after merge).
